subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: Should the Matrix-specific methods reachable through the documented supported `plugin-sdk/qa-runner-runtime` facade remain available as deprecated delegates, or may this cleanup remove them now?
rationale: The structural consolidation is sound, but repository policy treats supported Plugin SDK surface removals as compatibility-sensitive and the available evidence does not establish that downstream source-checkout/plugin consumers cannot use these methods.

options.title: Preserve deprecated delegates
options.body: Keep the Matrix methods on the supported facade as thin QA Lab delegates with focused compatibility coverage and a named future removal plan.

options.title: Approve immediate removal
options.body: Formally classify the Matrix methods as private repository-only surface, update the SDK documentation accordingly, and accept the current breaking cleanup.

recommendation.title: Preserve deprecated delegates
recommendation.body: Keep the Matrix methods on the supported facade as thin QA Lab delegates with focused compatibility coverage and a named future removal plan.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current QA Lab consolidation stack and have the most direct context on whether the facade was intended for consumers beyond the temporary plugin.
